4) If the complaint is “they built a bad bullpen” that doesn’t acknowledge that they were planning on being bad. They didn’t think they’d be this close and be wasting an elite offense with these late inning debacles. Hard to be mad they didn’t add a reliever to help the 68 win team they were supposed to be. 

5) This doesn’t change how demoralizing and infuriating these collapses are. To do so many things well and see games implode over and over is one of the hardest things in sports. 

Really exasperating for fans but kind of is a side effect to the team’s incredible offensive rise and over performance.

It’s like the lineup didn’t get the memo on what this season was supposed to be and it’s making the other stuff that hasn’t also overachieved that much more dispiriting for fans.

Sobering reminder that this probably isn’t a year that will end up being as fun in September as folks are dreaming about. 

In the mean time … Feels good to feel something I guess?

But how must the guys in the clubhouse feel? They do everything right and then lose. Over and over and over.

I get that this is year one and they probably won’t make the playoffs. I think you have to do something though. 

It’s just preposterous at this point. A lead of three runs or fewer always feels like a tie game. 

Tough way to live.
